item.description: Several Republicans in competitive races broke with President Trump on key agenda issues this week as voters continue to express concern about the economy and the war with Iran.

item.title: Africa wrestles with increasing deaths from non-communicable diseases
item.description: A new study from the Lancet out this week finds that non-communicable diseases accounted for nearly 5 million deaths across Africa in 2023, representing 45% of all deaths in Africa.

item.title: 'Acting is doing': Willem Dafoe on what people get wrong about acting

item.title: The Pacific is churning with hurricanes. The Atlantic is quiet. Blame El Niño
item.description: The Pacific Ocean has had an unusual number of storms this year, while the Atlantic hasn't recorded a single full-blown hurricane. Scientists point to an exceptionally strong El Niño.

The Pacific Ocean has had an unusual number of storms this year, while the Atlantic hasn't recorded a single full-blown hurricane. Scientists point to an exceptionally strong El Niño.
